what: Stacked sections turn one at a time by one wheel tick (|deltaY| ≥ 30), one vertical swipe (30px), the up/down keys, or the list buttons (700ms lock after each turn). The leaving section’s title line slides up −100% in .8s power3.inOut while its image shrinks to .85x and its text lifts 10px and fades out in .35s. The incoming title rises from 100% below on the same curve, after .4s the image pops out from .4x with elastic.out(1,.6) over 1.1s (any video inside plays once from the start), and the text floats up from 12px below at .08s intervals over .7s — for a portfolio list that shows one case at a time

options.threshold: Wheel deltaY counted as a flick · push distance (px), default 30
options.pop: Time when the picture starts popping out (s), default .4 — text follows .12s later
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Section title mask — its first child moves up and down
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Section inner graphic (pop-out) — if it contains a video, it plays once from the start when it enters
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Text and tags inside a section (fade in one by one)
options.[data-fx-part=nav]: Section number buttons — match sections in order, and the current one gets aria-current
options.fx:stage: Event fired from the board on each flip (detail.index)

note: To use vertical pushing as a page turn, touchmove in that direction is blocked (as in the original) — if the plate covers the full screen height, the page can’t scroll further on phones, so use it for one-screen list pages or keep the plate smaller than the screen. The original’s big sentence flowing behind sections (90px per second) is attached separately by putting the marquee part on the section background
